family_choice_cases.text: Upon expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
Any notice under this Agreement shall be delivered in writing by certified mail to the General Counsel at the address stated below.
Beginning on the first anniversary, the annual fees shall automatically increase by three percent (3%) each year.
Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to Supplier.
Customer must notify Supplier of any disputed invoice within thirty (30) days after the invoice date.
If monthly uptime falls below 99.9%, Customer may claim a service credit equal to ten percent (10%) of the monthly fee.
Claims for breach of warranty must be submitted in writing within ninety (90) days after delivery.
Amounts not paid when due will accrue a late charge of 1.5% per month until paid.
Supplier will issue Customer a five percent (5%) volume rebate after annual purchases exceed $500,000.
The receiving party shall protect Confidential Information using the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information.
This Agreement shall not automatically renew. Any extension beyond the Initial Term must be by written amendment signed by both parties.
Either party may elect not to renew the Agreement by giving written notice at least sixty (60) days before expiration of the then-current term.

termination_right.true_criteria: The chunk states an explicit right to terminate/cancel the agreement before its natural expiry, including convenience, cause, break, or early-exit rights.
termination_right.false_criteria: The chunk concerns only non-renewal, ordinary expiry, extension, or generic notice and does not grant an early termination right.

price_increase.true_criteria: The chunk states a change/increase/escalation/uplift/indexation to the contract price or recurring fee, or a right to object to such a price increase.
price_increase.false_criteria: The chunk concerns only late charges, default interest, penalties, service credits, rebates/refunds, or other amounts that are not an increase to the base contract price/fee.

renewal_notice.true_criteria: The chunk states contract term, effective date, expiry, renewal/non-renewal, or notice requirements specifically tied to renewal/non-renewal.
renewal_notice.false_criteria: The chunk is only a general notice provision or another clause family without renewal/non-renewal/term content.
